description.value:
Duration constant

You may issue your called command twice per round instead of once, but never twice to the same ally in the same round. The second command each round costs you an action even if the first did not.

cinderfall.incomplete: Lets the called command be used twice per round (never twice to the same ally); the second use costs an action even if the first didn't. The base "called command" mechanic carries no rule element to double -- same "nothing to extend" gap as cadre-ascendant. (Note: this card's own description is entirely about the Cadre "called command" mechanic despite being numbered into the Second trade's own tier progression in classes.deadhand.json -- a pre-existing content anomaly noted here, not corrected, since it's outside this pass's system.rules scope.)
